additional_concerns: Both format claims incorrectly say footnote 3 is missing. Unit da12aecad4e68.u30.3569 supplies it: "Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission." The listed methods are supported, but neither claim's conditions capture this mandatory qualification. They must not be read as unconditional permissions.

The XML claim also omits the requirements in da12aecad4e68.u14.2439 to follow the separately provided JFIU XML schema and liaise with the JFIU to arrange a technical test. These extraction omissions do not establish defects in formulas answering resubmission-trigger questions.

The prescribed PDF form and JFIU XML schema are not supplied. Their absence prevents checking detailed format compliance, although the circular itself establishes that these are permitted methods. The anonymous missing dependency IDs cannot reliably be mapped to either document.

node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 uses "[the fact filing_date] is greater than or equal to [date value 2026-02-02]". This includes the pre-9:00am blackout portion of that date. The calendar-date wording in da12aecad4e68.u3.811 and operational-launch wording in da12aecad4e68.u13.2131 require separate consideration when interpreting "following its implementation"; the date-only formula does not retain that distinction.

The other candidates select the 9:00am operational-launch interpretation. This has source support, but does not itself resolve the competing date-based reading or establish the governing timezone. An authoritative timezone clarification is missing and has no identifiable supplied dependency ID.

The blackout instruction permits direct contact for urgent STRs; it does not establish that every contact is a submission. Automatic migration of earlier STREAMS records is also distinct from a new submission. Classification must preserve these distinctions without excluding a genuine submission merely because it involved direct contact.

The history candidate delegates the existence test and evidential completeness to an externally supplied Boolean. Its formula does not inspect submission histories. A later STREAMS 2 resubmission does not erase a historical triggering event; these questions do not determine whether a duty remains outstanding.

Several event candidates place actual STR filing in scope, returning OUT_OF_SCOPE for nonfiling events, whereas node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb places submission in the result and can return false. The intended treatment of nonfiling original events needs clarification.

TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must be interpreted using the typed question: true means a duty was triggered, not that resubmission has been completed. None of these scoped assessments authorizes pruning claims or establishes overall candidate correctness.
